context: Tests the empty case: a clear message instead of a made-up resume.

checklist.name: No file read attempted
checklist.description: Does not try to read a context file that was not found

checklist.name: Exact message
checklist.description: Outputs "No context files found. Run `/save-context` to create one."

checklist.name: No invented state
checklist.description: Does not fabricate focus, goal or tasks

checklist.name: No file created
checklist.description: Does not create a context file itself

checklist.name: Save skill named
checklist.description: Points the user at save-context as the next step

checklist.name: Short reply
checklist.description: Answers in a few lines with no report scaffolding

checklist.name: No done/ marker
checklist.description: Does not add an archive marker or notice

checklist.name: Stops cleanly
checklist.description: Ends the turn after the message
